acceptance_criteria.statement: After build_packet every PACKET_PATHS entry exists, packet.json carries the head sha and review/repo contains a git checkout.
claims_markdown renders a Claims heading and unchecked claim items.
A transcript or author_reasoning source key is refused with packet_untrusted_source.
A packet head that differs from the checkout HEAD is refused with packet_head_mismatch.
A packet without a head sha is refused with packet_incomplete.

observable_behavior: build_packet writes every path in the skill's review/ layout
the checkout's HEAD must equal packet.head_sha
claims.md is a checklist of claims, never transcript text
outcome.summary: review-packet <repo>#<pr> stages the offline review/ tree from trusted sources only: the PR, checks and prior reviews from the GitHub API, the trusted gate's class/tier, verify records, base-branch leases/contracts and canonical related files. claims.md is the coordinator's own claim list; an author transcript or reasoning is refused as a source.

risk.blast_radius: all outside reviews; a poisoned packet makes an approval meaningless
reasons: the packet is the reviewer's only evidence; an untrusted or mislabeled source corrupts every verdict
